note: 身份：Starts the Crimson Isle Main Questline, and allows the player to switch Factions. 常驻： Stronghold / -364.5, 80, -476.5。与玩家关系：会随阵营、任务阶段或交易状态变化。说话层次：按 Wiki 原对白的身份与情绪自然口语化，不套统一客服腔。核心性格：仅从原文呈现，不额外添加人物关系或任务事实。固定词汇/禁用：NPC 人名与自造品牌保留英文；阵营、地名和机制沿用项目术语；不硬塞网络梗。

messages.text: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 等一下,我现在忙得不可开交!

messages.text: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你能不能别光站着,搭把手啊?!

messages.text: Wow, that was something!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哇,刚才可真够呛!

messages.text: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我虽然不怕火,可那些怪物还是相当难缠……

messages.text: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮忙,真的,太感谢了。

messages.text: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though. I need to collect 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks and I'm super late.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不过我赶时间。我得收集 2 份 Spectre Dust、3 份 Blaze Ashes 和 4 块 Magma Chunk,而且已经迟到很久了。

messages.text: Will you help me?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你愿意帮我吗?

messages.text: Okay, that's fine. I just won't be able to buy food today and I won't be able to pay my rent.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 好吧,没关系。无非就是我今天买不起饭,也交不起房租。

messages.text: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我去找那些东西时也可能送命,到时你良心上可得背着这件事。

messages.text: Have a nice day.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 祝你今天愉快。

messages.text: Thanks! You seem pretty strong, all you have to do is exterminate some of the monsters around. Follow me!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 谢啦! 你看着挺能打,只要清理掉附近几只怪物就好。跟我来!

messages.context: Elle：After Elle moves to the center of the  Stronghold
messages.text: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 就是这里。有些怪在楼里,沿路往前还能看到一些。小菜一碟!

messages.context: Elle：After Elle moves to the center of the  Stronghold
messages.text: I need 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我需要 2 份 Spectre Dust、3 份 Blaze Ashes 和 4 块 Magma Chunk。

messages.context: Elle：Before giving the requested items / Random
messages.text: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 附近大多数怪物都会掉值钱的东西,靠猎杀它们就能养活自己。

messages.text: I'll be right there, I need to catch my breath.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我就在这儿歇口气。

messages.text: I needed 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我要的是 2 份 Spectre Dust、3 份 Blaze Ashes 和 4 块 Magma Chunk。

messages.text: Oh, you already got everything?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,你已经全找齐了?

messages.text: Yoink!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 顺走咯!

messages.text: Thanks for the items, that's super nice of you!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 谢谢你送来这些东西,你人也太好了!

messages.text: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你是刚来这里的吧?我以前没见过你。

messages.text: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你大概正纳闷,这地方到底经历了什么吧?

messages.text: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 很久很久以前,这片土地其实是一座宁静的森林,还有农民在这里生活。

messages.text: When the Emperor Dragon destroyed the world something awakened deep below the surface.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 帝王龙毁灭世界时,地底深处的某种东西也苏醒了。

messages.text: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 巨大的火山拔地而起,并不断生长。几个世纪过去,整片土地也变得越来越糟。

messages.text: I've really got to go now but if you are interested I suggest you explore the island a bit more.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我真的得走了。不过你要是感兴趣,不妨再多探索一下这座岛。

messages.text: Thanks for your help, see you around!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮忙,回头见!

messages.context: Elle：Before attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut / Random
messages.text: Why don't you explore the Village a bit more?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不如再去村子里多转转?

messages.text: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你知道吧,真不用走到哪儿都跟着我。

messages.text: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Queen!
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实机采集确认了原文、空格与颜色边界；社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境与对话变体。
messages.zh: 哇,小心! 这栋建筑不能随便进去,这里可是女王的居所!

segments.text: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the
segments.zh: 哇,小心! 这栋建筑不能随便进去,这里可是

messages.raw: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the §2Queen§f!

messages.text: Wow careful, you can't simply enter this building, this place is the residence of the Chief!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哇,小心! 这栋建筑不能随便进去,这里可是酋长的居所!

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: There are 2 different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实机采集确认了原文、空格与颜色边界；社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境与对话变体。
messages.zh: 岛上有两个不同的阵营,双方关系紧张得不得了!

segments.text: on this island with incredible tensions between them!

messages.raw: There are 2 different §cFactions §fon this island with incredible tensions between them!

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 他们并不排斥旅行者,但你得先赢得信任,才能出入这种地方。

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: In fact, you'll have to choose a faction, but it's a little bit early for that.
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实机采集确认了原文、空格与颜色边界；社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境与对话变体。
messages.zh: 事实上,你迟早要选一个阵营,不过现在做决定还早了点。

segments.text: , but it's a little bit early for that.

messages.raw: In fact, you'll have to §2choose a faction§f, but it's a little bit early for that.

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: Joining a faction is an important choice, I suggest you get to know the two factions first.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 加入哪一方可是个重要选择。我建议你先了解一下两个阵营。

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: Perhaps you should start by talking to multiple villagers from each faction.
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实机采集确认了原文、空格与颜色边界；社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境与对话变体。
messages.zh: 先分别找两个阵营的几位村民聊聊吧。

segments.text: talking to multiple villagers from each faction
segments.zh: 分别找两个阵营的几位村民聊聊

messages.raw: Perhaps you should start by §2talking to multiple villagers from each faction§f.

messages.context: Elle：Right after attempting to enter the  Throne Room or  Chief's Hut
messages.text: The other faction is on the other side of the island.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 另一个阵营就在岛的另一边。

messages.context: Elle：Whilst talking to villagers from both Factions / Random
messages.text: The history between the 2 factions is long and complicated.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 两个阵营之间的恩怨又长又复杂。

messages.text: Talk to the villagers and come back to me.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 去和村民们聊聊,再回来找我。

messages.text: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 做决定前,别忘了也去听听另一个阵营的说法。

messages.context: Elle：Talking to Villagers in Both Factions
messages.text: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这么说,两个阵营的村民你都聊过几位了?不错。

messages.context: Elle：Talking to Villagers in Both Factions
messages.text: I hope you know which faction you want to join. But don't worry, you'll be able to change factions if you want.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 希望你已经想好要加入哪一方。不过别担心,以后想换阵营也可以。

messages.context: Elle：Talking to Villagers in Both Factions
messages.text: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 但换阵营通常意味着,你会和当前阵营交恶。

messages.context: Elle：Talking to Villagers in Both Factions
messages.text: Anyways, which faction did you choose?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 总之,你选哪个阵营?

messages.text: Hum, so you chose the Mage Faction then.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 嗯……原来你选了法师阵营。

messages.text: It's not going to be easy to join them.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 想加入他们可没那么容易。

messages.text: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 想得到加入的机会,你得先证明自己的价值。

messages.text: Hum, let me think...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 嗯,让我想想……

messages.text: Oh! I know what you should do!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦! 我知道该怎么办了!

messages.text: The Taika people really like educated individuals.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Taika 人特别欣赏有学问的人。

segments.zh: 人特别欣赏有学问的人。

messages.text: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, I'm sure they will take a liking to you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 如果你能带去一本他们没见过的书,或一件新奇的技术造物,他们肯定会对你另眼相看。

messages.text: I couldn't help but notice that you come from the place we commonly know as The Hub.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我注意到,你来自我们通常称作 大厅 的地方。

messages.text: In which case, you must have met Maddox?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那你一定见过 Maddox 吧?

segments.text: In which case, you must have met

messages.text: Both Maddox and his brother are in fact from Scarleton, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Maddox 和他的兄弟其实都来自绯红城,但和其他居民不同,这两兄弟天生没有任何魔法天赋。

segments.text: and his brother are in fact from
segments.zh: 和他的兄弟其实都来自

segments.text: , but contrary to the other inhabitants, the 2 brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
segments.zh: ,但和其他居民不同,这两兄弟天生没有任何魔法天赋。

messages.text: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 相反,他们展现出了惊人的力量,还格外热衷于暴力。

messages.text: They got banned from the Academy during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 入学第一年,他们就被学院开除了；后来又因一场可怕的事故,被逐出了整座岛。

segments.text: during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
segments.zh: 开除了；后来又因一场可怕的事故,被逐出了整座岛。

messages.text: But I digress. My point is they are both Taika, and I know for a fact that Aatrox is crafting simple Ability Phones for his brother.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 扯远了。重点是,他们都是 Taika 人,而且我确定 Aatrox 正在给他兄弟制作简易技能电话。

segments.text: But I digress. My point is they are both
segments.zh: 扯远了。重点是,他们都是

segments.text: , and I know for a fact that

segments.zh: 正在给他兄弟制作简易

messages.text: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from Maddox. I keep losing them.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 其实我手上就有一部。拿去吧,我再找 Maddox 要一部就行——反正我老是弄丢。

segments.text: In fact I have one myself. Here take it, I'll just request another one from
segments.zh: 其实我手上就有一部。拿去吧,我再找
要一部就行——反正我老是弄丢。

messages.text: Bring this to the Dean of the Academy in Scarleton, I'm sure he will find it quite interesting.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 把它带给绯红城学院的院长,他一定会很感兴趣。

segments.text: , I'm sure he will find it quite interesting.

messages.text: The Cathedral got reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the Academy.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 大教堂前阵子重新规划过,现在很大一部分区域都归学院使用。

segments.text: got reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the
segments.zh: 前阵子重新规划过,现在很大一部分区域都归

messages.text: Oh wow, it worked! I'm so happy for you!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哇,真的成功了! 真替你高兴!

messages.text: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my contact so we can stay in touch.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你甚至还拿到了 Abiphone! 保存我的联系方式,以后随时联系。

messages.text: Nice! So what are you up to?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不错嘛! 所以你现在在忙什么?

messages.text: The Dean told you his research got stolen?!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 院长说他的研究成果被偷了?!

messages.text: Ah, it's not so surprising, maybe you don't know but the Piglins are not so fond of the Taika people.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 啊,其实也不算意外。你可能不知道,猪灵 一向不太喜欢 Taika 人。

messages.text: I do have an idea where that stolen research might be, follow me.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我倒是想到一个地方,那份失窃的研究可能就在那里。跟我来。

messages.text: You see this giant Dragon Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 看见野蛮人阵营里的那具巨龙头骨了吗?

messages.text: That's the skeleton of Jythar the Eternal one - the one who caused the destruction of the world.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那是永恒者 Jythar 的遗骸——正是它曾毁灭了这个世界。

messages.text: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called Dragontail.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 现在你大概明白,前面的村庄为什么叫龙尾镇了。

messages.text: Anyways, the Barbarians built their Bastion inside the skeleton, and I suspect this is where the stolen object is guarded.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 总之,野蛮人把壁垒建在了遗骸内部。我怀疑失窃物品就被守在那里。

messages.text: Piglins fear the growing power of the Taika Kingdom, so they most likely stole it to study the research.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 猪灵 畏惧 Taika 王国日益壮大的力量,所以很可能是为了研究才把它偷走。

messages.text: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 也许你能偷偷潜进去把东西拿回来。当然,千万别被发现,更别闹出严重的外交事故。

messages.text: I'm not sure exactly where they keep it, but just make sure you don't get seen by the guards!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我不确定他们把东西藏在哪儿,总之别让卫兵看见你!

messages.text: I can't help you however, I have way too much to lose sorry. But good luck!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不过我不能陪你进去,抱歉,我承担不起那个后果。祝你好运!

messages.context: Elle：Before recovering the stolen research / Random
messages.text: Piglins can't see very far because of the fog, just don't stand in front of them.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 雾太大,猪灵 看不了多远。只要别杵在他们正前方就行。

messages.text: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?

messages.zh: 你到底知不知道要找什么?也许是本书,或者某件魔法物品?

messages.text: ✆ Hello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 喂?哦,你还活着,太棒了!

messages.text: ✆ Have you got the research back or did you chicken out?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 研究拿回来了吗,还是你临阵退缩了?

messages.text: ✆ Great! You are cooler than you look!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 太好了! 你比看上去厉害多了!

messages.text: ✆ Go back to the Dean then, I'm sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 那就回去找院长吧,这事肯定能让你赚到不少声望!

messages.text: ✆ Alright then! I have to go now, was nice talking to you!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 好啦! 我得走了,和你聊天很开心!

messages.text: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hum.

messages.zh: 你想加入野蛮人阵营,嗯……

messages.text: What a strange choice.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 真是个奇怪的选择。

messages.text: In any case, I have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不管怎样,我也不知道怎么才能保证他们收下你!

messages.text: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something I'm sure.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。

messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 一支空投艇编队正在接近! 趁还来得及把它们击落!

segments.text: are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!
segments.zh: 编队正在接近! 趁还来得及把它们击落!

messages.raw: A fleet of §cDropships§f are approaching! Take them down before it's too late!

messages.text: Look out, Magma Followers! Don't let them merge!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 小心，岩浆追随者! 别让它们融合!
messages.raw: Look out, §cMagma Followers§f! Don't let them merge!

messages.text: A group of Wandering Blazes are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 一群游荡烈焰人正从 Kuudra 嘴里冒出来!

segments.zh: 正从 Kuudra 嘴里冒出来!

messages.raw: A group of §cWandering Blazes§f are emerging from Kuudra's mouth!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Basic Tier and Hot Tier)
messages.text: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blows now!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 呼! 弩炮终于造好了! 现在应该足以扛住 Kuudra 的攻击!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Basic Tier and Hot Tier)
messages.text: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it must have fallen in the lava with the rest of my supplies!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 得找到弩炮的燃料，它肯定掉进熔岩里了，和我其他的物资一起!

segments.text: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it
must have fallen in the lava
with the rest of my supplies!

messages.raw: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it §cmust have fallen in the lava§f with the rest of my supplies!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Basic Tier and Hot Tier)
messages.text: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to shoot him with the Ballista!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Kuudra 又冒出来了! 该用弩炮射它了!

segments.text: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to
segments.zh: Kuudra 又冒出来了! 该

messages.raw: Looks like Kuudra has re-emerged! It's time to §cshoot him with the Ballista§f!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Burning Tier, Fiery Tier and Infernal Tier)
messages.text: Phew! The Ballista is finally ready! It should be strong enough to tank Kuudra's blow!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 呼! 弩炮终于造好了! 现在应该足以扛住 Kuudra 的攻击!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Burning Tier, Fiery Tier and Infernal Tier)
messages.text: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it must be fallen into the lava with the rest of my supplies!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们得找到弩炮燃料,它肯定和其他物资一起掉进熔岩了!

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Burning Tier, Fiery Tier and Infernal Tier)
messages.text: Huh, what is that noise?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 咦,那是什么声音?

messages.context: Elle：When the Ballista is built (Burning Tier, Fiery Tier and Infernal Tier)
messages.text: Whow...WHOW! What's happening!!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哇……哇啊! 发生什么了!!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is outside
messages.text: *muffles*Help! I'm still alive in here! It stinks!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: *含糊不清*救命! 我还活着! 这里臭死了!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is outside
messages.text: *muffles*I think I'm in Kuudra's Belly! I was standing too close!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: *含糊不清*我好像在 Kuudra 肚子里! 刚才站得太近了!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is outside
messages.text: *muffles*See if you can find a way to get in here too! I see something which may help us kill Kuudra!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: *含糊不清*想办法也进来! 我看见了某种也许能杀死 Kuudra 的东西!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
messages.text: Oh, funny seeing you here.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哦,真巧,居然在这里见到你。

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
messages.text: What? Yes I am still alive. I landed in Kuudra's belly here.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 怎么?对,我还活着。我掉进 Kuudra 的肚子里了。

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
messages.text: It looks like if we mine these purple pods, we can do some real damage to Kuudra!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 看来只要挖掉这些紫色囊泡,就能真正重创 Kuudra!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
messages.text: Oh come on! What is it this time!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不会吧! 这次又是什么!

messages.context: Elle：When in Kuudra's Belly and the player is inside
messages.text: I'll fight the mobs, you focus on destroying these pods!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我来对付怪物,你专心摧毁这些囊泡!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra submerged while in his belly
messages.text: The lava level is rising inside Kuudra! He must have submerged under the lava!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Kuudra 体内的熔岩正在上涨! 它一定潜进熔岩下面了!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra submerged while in his belly
messages.text: We need to get out before we burn in this lava!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 得赶在被熔岩烧死前逃出去!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra submerged while in his belly
messages.text: We can escape back out his throat at the top of his stomach!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 可以从胃顶端沿着它的喉咙逃出去!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra submerged while in his belly
messages.text: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra submerged while in his belly
messages.text: When Kuudra submerges, we will be flushed out of his stomach! We need to get back inside but be careful when he submerges!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Kuudra 下潜时,我们会被冲出它的胃! 还得重新进去,但它下潜时一定要小心!

messages.text: That looks like it hurt! Quickly, while Kuudra is distracted shoot him with the Ballista!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这一下看着就疼! 快,趁 Kuudra 分神,用弩炮轰它!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra dies in Basic Tier, Hot Tier, Burning Tier and Fiery Tier
messages.text: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! I don't think he has any more in him!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 砰! 这下总该结束了! 它肯定再也撑不住了!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra dies in Basic Tier, Hot Tier, Burning Tier and Fiery Tier
messages.text: I knew you could do it!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我就知道你们能做到!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra dies in Basic Tier, Hot Tier, Burning Tier and Fiery Tier
messages.text: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 认输前还要最后挣扎一下,是吧?

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra dies in Basic Tier, Hot Tier, Burning Tier and Fiery Tier
messages.text: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 大家干得好,这场苦战终于结束了。趁麻烦还没找上门,赶紧离开这里!

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra's Lair is opening in Infernal Tier
messages.text: What's happening? Why isn't he dying?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 怎么回事?它为什么还没死?

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra's Lair is opening in Infernal Tier
messages.text: What just happened? Is this Kuudra's real lair?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 刚才发生了什么?这里才是 Kuudra 真正的巢穴吗?

messages.context: Elle：When Kuudra's Lair is opening in Infernal Tier
messages.text: I'm not going down there... that's all you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我可不下去……接下来全靠你们了。

messages.text: How do you like your Faction?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你觉得现在的阵营怎么样?

messages.text: If you want to swap Factions let me know, it really isn't that hard.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 想换阵营就告诉我,其实没那么难。

messages.text: All you have to do is lose all your Reputation points, we call that "becoming neutral".
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只要失去全部声望点数就行,我们把这种状态叫作“变为中立”。

messages.text: If you go neutral, let me know!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 变为中立后记得告诉我!

messages.text: Do you want to change your Faction?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你想更换阵营吗?

messages.text: Great!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 太好了!

messages.text: You want to join the Barbarian Faction, hmm.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你想加入野蛮人阵营,嗯……
messages.raw: You want to join the §cBarbarian Faction§f, hmm.

messages.text: So you want to join the Mage Faction then...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 所以你想加入法师阵营……

messages.text: You want to change factions AGAIN?!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你又想换阵营?!

messages.text: Well because you already joined that faction in the past, all you have to do is go to their Community Center.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 既然你以前加入过那个阵营,只要去他们的社区中心就行。

messages.text: From their Town Board you can sign up to their Faction again as long as you were a part of it in the past!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只要过去曾是其中一员,就能在城镇公告板上重新加入那个阵营!

messages.text: I'M UP HERE! ON TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN!!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我在上面! 山顶上!!
